segments.thig5.6:2.3: Kilesānaṃ vasaṃ gantvā, sāmaññatthaṃ na bujjhihaṃ.
segments.thig5.6:4.1: “Appakaṃ jīvitaṃ mayhaṃ, jarā byādhi ca maddati;
segments.thig5.6:4.3: Purāyaṃ bhijjati [jarāya bhijjate (sī.)] kāyo, na me kālo pamajjituṃ.
segments.thig5.6:5.3: Vimuttacittā uṭṭhāsiṃ, kataṃ buddhassa sāsana” ntntti.

lines: Yathābhūtamavekkhantīti evaṃ jātasaṃvegā vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapetvā aniccādimanasikārena yathābhūtamavekkhantī.

“Avijjāsamudayā rūpasamudayo”tiādinā (paṭi. ma.1.50) samapaññāsappabhedānaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ uppādanirodhañca udayabbayānupassanāya avekkhantī vipassanaṃ ussukkāpetvā maggapaṭipāṭiyā sabbaso kilesehi ca bhavehi ca vimuttacittā uṭṭhāsiṃ, ubhato uṭṭhānena maggena bhavattayato cāti vuṭṭhitā ahosiṃ.
